crossRefs.note: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;

people.name: Hannathon
people.line: A border town in the territory of Zebulun.

people.name: Iphtahel_Valley
people.line: A valley on the border of Zebulun and Asher

translations.web: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;
translations.bsb: Then the border circled around the north side of Neah to Hannathon and ended at the Valley of Iphtah-el.
translations.kjv: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthahel:
translations.asv: and the border turned about it on the north to Hannathon; and the goings out thereof were at the valley of Iphtah-el;
